property_summary: For any initial MinSum and any nonzero _val, a single call to SetMinSum(_val) on an uninitialized contract sets MinSum exactly to _val (replacement), whereas the mutant that adds instead will make MinSum = old + _val and thus violate this when old != 0; we fuzz both the initial MinSum by calling SetMinSum once with a first fuzzed value and then call SetMinSum again with a second fuzzed value — the reference will have MinSum equal to the second value, the mutant will differ for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the assignment to add the provided value to the existing MinSum instead of replacing it, altering the resulting MinSum seen externally.
